name: Hell's Gate
source:
Long ago there were angels and demons in this world. However, a conflict over a trivial matter divided the world into Heaven and Hell.
At the border only gatekeeper Elle protects the shaky peace. One day angel Yuu shows up before her. Elle tries to catch Yuu, but...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，这个世界上有天使和恶魔。然而，因为一件琐事的冲突，世界被分成了天堂和地狱。在边界处，只有守护者艾尔守护着岌岌可危的和平。一天，天使优出现在她面前。艾尔试图抓住优，但……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
